title: Vintage The Penthouse 1981 Desk Calendar Pet Photos Earl Miller

description:
The Penthouse 1981 Desk Calendar, staple-bound week-by-month planner with Penthouse Pet photography (e.g. Tammy Hill, photographed by Earl Miller).

Interior pages are clean, with no writing in the pages shown. The purple covers show scuffs, surface creases and edge wear, mostly on the back cover - see photos.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. Ships flat in a plain, protective mailer.
